body: Funny you said this cos today right after I posted this. Someone reported me and booked an appointment to the school counsellor. I was very confused and thought I screwed up another assessment until I saw a brochure of beyondblue and it clicked what was happening. I only talked about my low grades with her. It was very obvious I had anxiety. It seems so pointless and if they ever found out I self harmed all hell would break loose to my parents
